purpose: Frozen solver-neutral R100A-4 benchmark authority for R100B bakeoff, including explicit radiation termination and finite-record P/Q transfer semantics.

hard_gates.requirement: Required observables must satisfy their fixture-specific tolerances against analytical, closed-form, invariant, peer or independent reference evidence.
Production candidates must pass correctness on CPU without requiring GPU acceleration.
Production candidates must be reproducibly installable/embeddable on Windows 11 x64 with Python 3.12 or an explicitly packaged native adapter.
License and redistribution terms must permit the intended personal Windows distribution; evidence is recorded in R100B.
A candidate is scored only for roles whose declared capabilities and compiled representations cover the fixture; unsupported outputs remain unsupported.
Backend/version, precision, source normalization, frequency/time grid, seed and all approximation controls must be recorded so an accepted result can be replayed.

fixtures.description: 4 x 5 x 2.5 m rigid rectangular room analytical eigenfrequencies.
notes: Lossless eigenmode validation is not an FR/RT60 claim.

fixtures.description: 6 x 4 x 2.5 m rigid room convergence fixture for grid/mesh refinement and transfer comparison.

observables.reference_description: Complex finite-record pressure/volume-velocity transfer P_T(f)/Q_T(f); error against the finest accepted/reference representation must decrease under declared refinement.

notes: Refinement parameter and interpolation location must be recorded by the adapter.
Finite-time/FR postprocessing must use the declared source normalization and time reference.
Complex field convergence uses complex RMS absolute/relative error; phase is not double-scored as a separate zero-degree tolerance.

R100A-4 finite-record authority: use solver-native recorded dt, samples with 0 <= n*dt < 2 s, direct scored-frequency DTFT, and P(f)/Q(f) normalization from the actual injected unit-sample volume-velocity record.

fixtures.description: Normal-incidence reflection from Z=2*rho*c, giving closed-form complex R=1/3.

materials.provenance: R100A closed-form normal-incidence impedance, rho=1.2 kg/m3, c=343 m/s

observables.reference_description: For normal incidence, R=(Z-rho*c)/(Z+rho*c)=1/3 with zero phase.

notes: Scalar absorption must not be converted to phase-bearing impedance.

fixtures.description: Concave L-shaped polygon prism for independent-reference arbitrary-room wave comparison.

observables.reference_description: Compare 20*log10(|P_T/Q_T|/(1 Pa/(m3/s))) against an independently implemented finite-record reference discretization on the exact concave prism.
Phase comparison uses the same source, Fourier sign, time zero and null mask.

notes: R100A-4 finite-record authority: use solver-native recorded dt, samples with 0 <= n*dt < 2 s, direct scored-frequency DTFT, and P(f)/Q(f) normalization from the actual injected unit-sample volume-velocity record.

fixtures.description: Two 3 m regions forming the same 6 m room, connected by an explicit full-height Portal.

materials.provenance: R100A semantic aperture placeholder; Portal or BoundaryTermination owns the opening physics

observables.reference_description: Splitting an acoustically identical volume by an internal continuity portal must preserve transfer within discretization tolerance.
Internal region partitioning must not introduce a physical phase discontinuity.

notes: The interface placeholder is not a material model; Portal semantics own the opening.

fixtures.description: Single rectangular region with an explicitly frozen local first-order outgoing radiation termination on the x=6 m aperture.

materials.provenance: R100A semantic aperture placeholder; Portal or BoundaryTermination owns the opening physics

observables.reference_description: R100A-3 semi-analytical rectangular-waveguide modal Green-function reference for the exact local first-order outgoing Robin termination; transfer magnitude is 20*log10(|P/Q| / (1 Pa/(m3/s))), with Q frozen by the source authority; normalized Neumann transverse modes, rigid x=0/y/z walls and dp/dn-i*k*p=0 at x=6 m.
Complex pressure samples from the same R100A-3 semi-analytical modal Green-function reference; this preserves magnitude and phase under exp(-i*omega*t).

notes: R100A-3 radiation authority: outward normal is from the modeled region; p/u_n=rho*c; k=omega/c; with exp(-i*omega*t), dp/dn-i*k*p=0.
The radiation model is a local first-order outgoing approximation, not an exact arbitrary-incidence exterior-domain solution.

Reference samples use normalized Neumann transverse modes and an analytic one-dimensional Green function per mode. Modal truncation N=12 is independently convergence-qualified by the repository checker.
Magnitude acceptance uses absolute dB error only; complex-pressure acceptance carries the 8% relative magnitude and 8 degree phase limits so dB values are never treated as linear quantities.
Changing termination kind, radiation model, sign convention, normal convention, or reference samples is a semantic fixture change and must change benchmark identity.

fixtures.description: Closed-form direct path and first specular reflection in a 6 x 5 x 3 m room.

observables.reference_description: Image source across y=0 gives the specular point (2.5,0,1).
Image-source reflected path length across y=0.

notes: Path geometry alone does not authorize a coherent broadband complex response.

fixtures.description: Specular box obstacle representing a kitchen counter in the same reference room.

observables.reference_description: Adding a participating reflecting obstacle must change the deterministic path set; it must not be ignored as visual-only furniture.

notes: Object acoustic participation is explicit and independent of editor hide/lock state.

fixtures.description: Stochastic-ray identity and estimator repeatability fixture with explicit scattering, seed and resource controls.

observables.reference_description: Same declared seed and estimator settings must reproduce the same stochastic estimate within numerical tolerance.

notes: R150 must additionally refine ray count, receiver estimator/radius, time-bin width and termination; seed repeatability alone is insufficient.

fixtures.description: Typed wave/geometric overlap contract; only compatible quantities may be stitched.

observables.reference_description: Validated overlap must remain level-continuous; a gap remains a gap instead of fabricated broadband data.

notes: No stochastic late-field phase may be invented.
FR acceptance does not imply IR/decay acceptance; frequency-domain IR synthesis has a separate gate.
